title: Queen Selena: A Tribute to the Latin Pop Superstar in Las Vegas
blurb: Experience the magic of Selena live in Las Vegas! Queen Selena is a vibrant tribute show starring the incredible Yailen Hernandez with a full live band, bringing Selena’s greatest hits to life with passion, power, and authenticity. Dance and sing along to unforgettable songs like “Bidi Bidi Bom Bom,” “Como La Flor,” and “Dreaming of You” in an exciting, high-energy atmosphere that captures the heart and soul of the Queen of Latin Pop. A must-see for fans, music lovers, and travelers looking for an unforgettable night out!
